The '''Kantel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="MC" /> located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]]. While Tyed Kant was the system's only planet, the system was surrounded by two gargantuan bands of orbiting dust and captured debris.<ref name="MC" />
